description.zh:
集成的云服务类型。包括：

- direct: 云产品自监控集成
- cms: 企业云监控集成
description.en:
The type of integrated cloud service. Valid values:

- `direct`: An integration for cloud products that are monitored by the product itself.

- `cms`: An integration with CloudMonitor.

title.en: Query the collection status of Alibaba Cloud services

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-cms-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id n9p9o9o3se --type-filter direct --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListCmsInstances --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId n9p9o9o3se --TypeFilter direct --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
